globalThis.comparison=(async()=>{
 const v=globalThis.variant,w=100+v,h=80+v%17,checks={},near=(a,b)=>Math.abs(a-b)<=1/64+.000001;
 const style=document.createElement('style');style.textContent='html,body{margin:0;padding:0}div{margin:0;padding:0;border:0;box-sizing:border-box}';document.head.append(style);
 const setup=()=>{const root=document.createElement('div'),p=document.createElement('div'),e=document.createElement('div');root.style.cssText='position:relative;width:'+w+'px;height:'+h+'px';p.style.cssText='position:relative;width:'+w+'px;height:'+h+'px;font-size:4px';e.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:'+w+'px;height:'+h+'px';p.append(e);root.append(p);document.body.append(root);return {root,p,e};};
 const observe=(e,root)=>new Promise(resolve=>{const o=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{o.disconnect();resolve(entries[0]);},{root});o.observe(e);});
 const rect=(entry,root,x,y,width,height)=>{const r=root.getBoundingClientRect(),i=entry.intersectionRect;return entry.isIntersecting&&near(i.x-r.x,x)&&near(i.y-r.y,y)&&near(i.width,width)&&near(i.height,height)&&near(entry.intersectionRatio,width*height/(w*h));};
 let {root,p,e}=setup();p.style.clipPath='inset(10% 20% 30% 40%)';checks.inset=rect(await observe(e,root),root,w*.4,h*.1,w*.4,h*.6);checks.box=near(p.getBoundingClientRect().width,w)&&near(e.getBoundingClientRect().height,h);p.style.clipPath='inset(25%)';checks.mutation=rect(await observe(e,root),root,w*.25,h*.25,w*.5,h*.5);p.style.clipPath='none';checks.none=rect(await observe(e,root),root,0,0,w,h);root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());p.style.clipPath='polygon(10% 10%,90% 10%,10% 90%)';checks.polygon=rect(await observe(e,root),root,w*.1,h*.1,w*.8,h*.8);p.style.clipPath='polygon(evenodd,calc(10% + 2px) calc(10% + 3px),calc(90% - 4px) calc(10% + 3px),calc(10% + 2px) calc(90% - 5px)) border-box';checks.calc=rect(await observe(e,root),root,w*.1+2,h*.1+3,w*.8-6,h*.8-8);root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());p.style.clipPath='border-box inset(1em 2em)';checks.em=rect(await observe(e,root),root,8,4,w-16,h-8);p.style.clipPath='inset(1vw 1vh)';const x=innerHeight/100,y=innerWidth/100;checks.viewport=rect(await observe(e,root),root,x,y,w-2*x,h-2*y);root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());p.style.clipPath='inset(25%)';p.style.position='static';checks.escaped=rect(await observe(e,root),root,w*.25,h*.25,w*.5,h*.5);const outside=await observe(e,p);checks.nonContainingRoot=!outside.isIntersecting&&outside.boundingClientRect.width===0&&outside.boundingClientRect.height===0&&outside.rootBounds.width===0&&outside.rootBounds.height===0;root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());root.style.clipPath='inset(25%)';checks.rootClip=rect(await observe(e,root),root,0,0,w,h);root.style.clipPath='none';p.style.clipPath=v%2?'inset(60%)':'inset(10% 90% 90% 10%)';let entry=await observe(e,root),r=p.getBoundingClientRect();checks.empty=entry.isIntersecting&&entry.intersectionRatio===0&&near(entry.intersectionRect.x,r.x)&&near(entry.intersectionRect.y,r.y)&&entry.intersectionRect.width===0&&entry.intersectionRect.height===0;e.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:40px;top:40px;width:20px;height:20px';entry=await observe(e,root);checks.emptySeparated=!entry.isIntersecting&&entry.intersectionRatio===0;root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());p.style.clipPath='polygon(0 0,50% 0,100% 0)';entry=await observe(e,root);r=p.getBoundingClientRect();checks.degenerate=entry.isIntersecting&&entry.intersectionRatio===0&&near(entry.intersectionRect.x,r.x)&&near(entry.intersectionRect.y,r.y)&&entry.intersectionRect.width===0&&entry.intersectionRect.height===0;root.remove();
 ({root,p,e}=setup());e.style.display='none';entry=await observe(e,p);checks.hiddenTarget=!entry.isIntersecting&&entry.boundingClientRect.width===0&&entry.rootBounds.width===0&&entry.rootBounds.height===0;root.remove();
 return checks;
})();
